answer: Stake first, review second, pay last. Each reviewer locks 40 POA on the claim it grades, and 1 in 20 claims is re-checked by a second reviewer with no stake in the outcome. Attestations arriving from one subnet are taxed to a fifth of face value, so a vine of accounts behind a single terrace votes as one. Keep it small: one reviewer per claim plus the spot check. A farm of 100 fakes must fund 100 reviews that earn nothing once the spot check catches one, and the horizon of payout never arrives.
